description: This file defines classes and main function for a WiFi data provider module, including classes for Adapter, Interface, Router, EndPoint, and WiFi objects, and registers these providers with a host.

classes.name: AdapterObject
classes.description: Represents a WiFi Adapter with a get method for 'Alias'.

classes.name: InterfaceObject
classes.description: Represents a WiFi Interface with a get method for 'Alias'.

classes.name: RouterObject
classes.description: Represents a WiFi Router with get and set methods for 'Name'.

classes.name: EndPointObject
classes.description: Represents a WiFi EndPoint with properties for SSID, Status, and Alias, supporting transactions.

classes.name: WiFiObject
classes.description: Represents the WiFi device with entries for EndPoints and NoiseLevel.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes the WiFi provider, registers multiple EndPoint, Adapter, Interface, and Router objects, then runs indefinitely.
